text: Ask your AI to log breakfast... and it hits a wall.
Most of the apps you live in have no API. Your AI can't touch them.
Y C Y C connects them. Even the ones with no API.
Pick an app. Sign in on its own page.
Y C Y C reads your account, writes the tools, and tests a real request.
Then ONE link... goes into every assistant you use.
Now Claude can log it. Anything that writes waits for your OK.
Every app Y C Y C learns, it learns once, for everyone.
Flo. Cronometer. ParkMobile. Whatever you open next.
Built today at Y C, with Capy, Revyl, and Convex.
Y C Y C. Your apps, in every AI.
